Publication of Code

The Spokane Municipal Code shall be published pursuant to the following schedule and standards:

  1. The Spokane Municipal Code shall be republished on a calendar quarterly basis at the end of each calendar quarter.
     
  2. Each republication of the code shall include publication on the City’s website at the time of each republication.
     
  3. Publication on the City’s website shall include a search engine at the site of each republished code that is for the context of the code.
     
  4. Copies of each republication of the code shall be made available for download on the City’s website. The City will also provide a text-based format on CD to any database provider upon request, free of charge.

Date Passed: Monday, January 22, 2007

Effective Date: Sunday, March 4, 2007

Recodification ORD C33969 Section 1
